new_commodity_proposals.evidence: Not already priced under another spelling: chicken-breast is the boneless breast tray, boneless-skinless-chicken-thigh is thigh, and no board or feed label carries 'tenderloin', 'tenders' or 'strips' as raw chicken. Tenderloins sell on their own tray above breast per lb, so the breast id would understate the batch's 5 lb of protein.

Checked the obvious variants - corn meal, polenta, masa, grits, corn flour - and no commodity or board row prices any of them; `flour` is wheat all-purpose and a different bag and price. Captures carry cornmeal today, so this is a genuine gap, not a duplicate.
